Spark Flick.subject: a single bright spark flung from a snapping finger and thumb, trailing tiny glowing flecks

Soothing Touch.subject: an open palm laid on a bruised forearm, soft warm light easing the wound

Chill Breath.subject: a thin plume of frosty breath drifting from pursed lips, ice crystals forming in the air

Dazzle.subject: a sudden burst of blinding glittering light between two raised fingers, scattering rays

Muffle.subject: a hand pressing a soft grey cloth of silence over swirling fading sound waves

Tripwire Hex.subject: a nearly invisible glowing thread stretched low across a stone floor, tiny runes at each end

Ember Dart.subject: a small flaming dart streaking forward, trailing sparks and a thin line of smoke

Searing Brand.subject: a glowing red-hot brand pressed into charred skin, a spiral rune burning in orange fire

Smoke Veil.subject: thick swirling grey smoke curtain lit from within by dull orange embers

Cinder Cloud.subject: a roiling cloud of glowing cinders and ash billowing outward, flickering with red light

Pyre Lance.subject: a long spear of concentrated white-orange flame hurtling forward, wreathed in roaring fire

Shade Bolt.subject: a streaking bolt of solid darkness with a cold violet-black glow trailing wisps of shadow

Grasping Shadows.subject: dark clawed hands of shadow reaching up from the floor to seize at ankles

Gloam Daze.subject: a spiral of dim shadowy motes swirling around a dazed pale face, eyes unfocused

Pall of Dread.subject: a heavy black shroud of fear descending, ghostly screaming faces pressed in the folds

Hollow Scream.subject: a ghostly open mouth screaming, shockwaves of dark sickly green energy rippling outward

Mending Moss.subject: a patch of glowing green moss spreading over a wound, tiny leaves unfurling

Fen Fog.subject: low pale marsh fog rolling across dark water, reeds and faint will-o-wisp glints in the mist

Bramble Snare.subject: thick thorny brambles erupting from the ground and coiling tightly around a boot

Sour Blood.subject: a vial-shaped drop of dark green curdled blood spreading through veins in a clenched hand

Withering Glance.subject: an eye with a dying leaf-green iris, nearby plants browning and crumbling to dust

Crow-Knot Curse.subject: a black crow feather tied in a tight knot of red thread, dark green glow around it

Hearth Mending.subject: gentle golden firelight knitting together a torn cloth and cracked skin, tiny floating embers

Hearth Spark.subject: a small bright golden flame floating above an open palm, warm and steady

Hearthward Rebuke.subject: a golden flaming hand raised in a stern warding gesture, blazing light pushing back

Hush of the Hearth.subject: a calm circle of warm golden glow quieting swirling noise, a finger raised to lips

Mercy of the Hearth.subject: a kneeling figure bathed in soft golden fire as wounds close, radiant sparks rising

Hearthfire Smite.subject: a sword blade wreathed in blazing golden fire striking down in a bright arc

Stilling Word.subject: a single glowing golden rune hanging in the air, rings of light freezing a rushing figure

Last Light.subject: a lone golden flame guttering in vast darkness, casting a final stubborn halo
